title: Delivery retries
text: A failed delivery is retried with exponential backoff. Use an operation ID so a retry does not apply the same action twice.

title: Rotating service keys
text: Create a replacement service key before retiring the old key. Move clients to the replacement, verify traffic, then revoke the old key.

title: Restoring a snapshot
text: Choose a completed snapshot, restore it into an isolated workspace, and verify its checksums before switching the application to restored data.

title: Request rate limits
text: A rate limit controls requests per interval. When a server returns 429, respect Retry-After and pause before retrying the request.

title: Certificate renewal
text: Renew a TLS certificate before its expiration date. Deploy the certificate with its intermediate chain and verify the hostname from a client.

title: DNS cache changes
text: A DNS record update may take time to appear because resolvers keep cached answers until the record time to live expires.

title: Resuming an upload
text: Split a large upload into numbered parts. Save the confirmed part IDs and resume only missing parts after an interrupted connection.

title: Verifying webhook delivery
text: Validate the webhook signature over the original request bytes. Reject stale timestamps and deduplicate repeated delivery IDs.

title: Removing secrets from logs
text: Log request IDs and error codes. Redact service keys, session cookies and authorization headers before writing application logs.

title: Recovering a queue worker
text: A worker acknowledges a message only after storing the result. An expired lease allows another worker to retry, using the same operation ID.

title: Ending a user session
text: A logout invalidates the server-side session and clears the client cookie. Password changes should also revoke older active sessions.

title: Exporting a report
text: Export a report as UTF-8 CSV with a header row. Escape quotes and preserve embedded newlines so spreadsheet readers can parse every field.
